_comment: Row 753. The channel reader's finish-early deadline is measured on the OWNER'S clock: the runner's /proc/uptime sample its budget was computed from, less the lateness the reader measures at its own first line. Anchors are zero-width execution positions on the two decisions -- the lateness term in the window and the admission of the anchor argument -- with no value inside any matched span.
subject: the terminal reader ends inside its timeout(1) owner's budget however late the interpreter starts, so contention cannot turn a settled reader into status 124

mutants.label: M1 the reader's window ignores the lateness it measured
M2 the reader never admits the owner's anchor
